data.name: Undying Hatred Stain
data.description: When you begin your turn with a helpless foe within 5 feet of your reach, you must attempt a Will save (DC %1). If you fail, you must attempt a coup de grace against that foe this round if possible.|15+AccursedManifestationLevel
